# ractermx_domain_statistics (Data Source)

Reads email statistics for a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read email statistics for a domain.
data "ractermx_domain_statistics" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
  date_from = "2024-01-01"
  date_to   = "2024-01-31"
}

output "total_forwarded" {
  value = data.ractermx_domain_statistics.example.total_forwarded
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Optional

- `date_from` (String) Start date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD format).
- `date_to` (String) End date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD format).

### Read-Only

- `total_bounced` (Number) Total number of emails bounced.
- `total_deferred` (Number) Total number of emails deferred.
- `total_forwarded` (Number) Total number of emails forwarded.
- `total_received` (Number) Total number of emails received.
- `total_rejected` (Number) Total number of emails rejected.
